messages:
maya (Support): escalation incoming — customer C-3245 reports that responses changed after last night's chat-template rollout. they say reprompts are being truncated and sometimes omitted. attaching customer examples below.

lia (Customer): hi team — here are the two snippets. before rollout (Sat):
```
User: Please summarize the conversation below and list follow-up questions.
System: \n
Assistant: Sure — here's a summary and questions:
1) ...
2) ...
```
After rollout (Sun):
```
User: Please summarize the conversation below and list follow-up questions.
System:\u00A0
Assistant: Sorry, I need more info.
```
The system prompt used to be an explicit separate message. Now it looks merged/blank and assistant asks for more info. Happens consistently for long prompts or prompts starting with NBSP.

maya (Support): we collected request ids: r-7a1c9f, r-7a1c9f-retry, r-8b2d01. customer is on hosted. they pinned model=redwood-chat-1.5, previously fine.

deploy-bot: rollout completed: chat-template-service v2.4 -> v2.5 at 1968490000 by deploy pipeline :rocket:.

jordan (Eng-ML): can you paste the exact payload the customer sent (headers redacted)? need to reproduce tokenization differences.

maya (Support): pasting sanitized payload:
```
POST /v1/chat/completions
{
  "model": "redwood-chat-1.5",
  "messages": [
    {"role":"system","content":"You are an assistant that summarizes conversations."},
    {"role":"user","content":"\u00A0Please summarize the conversation below and list follow-up questions."}
  ],
  "temperature": 0.2
}
```
Note: user content begins with a non-breaking space (\u00A0) — customer says they didn't add it intentionally, but it appears after an internal copy/paste from their UI.

sam (Eng-Runtime): interesting — v2.5 of templates removed the explicit leading newline in system messages and also merged adjacent messages if the separator was only whitespace. probable regression point.

jordan (Eng-ML): i can reproduce locally when tokenizer normalizes NBSP differently: tokens show as ["\u00A0Please", "summarize", ...] which makes the system token merge into user token stream in some template concatenation logic.

tess (Product): is there a quick mitigation we can offer customer while we fix? rollback or pin older template?

maya (Support): customer prefers not to rollback infra. requested a config workaround they can set on their account.

jordan (Eng-ML): temporary mitigation: set chat_template_version=2.4 in the request metadata (we expose as header X-Redwood-Template: v2.4) — that preserves previous separator behavior. also recommend stripping NBSP on client side.

sam (Eng-Runtime): i'll open a hotfix to treat NBSP as explicit whitespace token during template join, so it doesn't collapse separators. creating PR now.

jordan (Eng-ML): add test cases for leading NBSP, leading "\n" and empty-system content. also add a fuzz test for copy-paste artifacts.

maya (Support): sent customer the workaround header and asked for confirmation. lia, can you confirm if header fixes their flow?

lia (Customer): applied header and retested — flows look identical to pre-rollout. thanks, please keep me posted on permanent fix.

sam (Eng-Runtime): PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/chat-templates/pull/421 — change normalizer to map NBSP->U+0020 before joining. targeting patch deploy in next deploy window (4h).

jordan (Eng-ML): noted for release notes and evals: we should include tokenization-impact checklist for any template change.

tess (Product): assigning follow-up: create KB article for customers hitting NBSP/copy-paste issues + header workaround.

maya (Support): closing loop with customer; keeping thread open until patch is live. next update in ~3h. :white_check_mark:
